snippet:
Historically, an MVRV above ~3.7 has signaled overvaluation and market euphoria, while an MVRV below 1 suggests undervaluation and possible capitulation,
The market value of Bitcoin is its total circulating supply multiplied by its current price, while the realized value calculates the value of all coins at the price they last changed hands.
